cycle_report.summary: Cycle 2 successfully hardened and finalized the Stripe credit payment flow for AI-StoryForge. All four priority items were completed: (1) email confirmation fully wired to the existing SMTP infrastructure — _send_purchase_confirmation_email() now calls _send_email_message() → smtplib, no longer a stub; (2) billing dashboard UI verified via Selenium screenshot — all 4 sections (credit balance, credit store, usage analytics, purchase history) render correctly with proper empty-state handling; (3) end-to-end credit provisioning validated through synthetic webhook events — 9/9 mock E2E tests passed including idempotency, transaction logging, and multi-purchase accumulation; (4) polish and hardening items completed — rate limiting (10/minute) on checkout, copy-to-clipboard on receipt, success/cancel toast notifications, and empty purchase history messaging. All 186 regression tests pass.

workspace/AI-StoryForge/web/templates/billing.html — success/cancel toast notifications wired at ?success=1 and ?cancelled=1 query params, empty purchase history 'No purchases yet' message confirmed
